mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SUPPLEMENT_ORDER ( ID, ORDER_NO, PAY_STATUS, THIRD_USER_ID, CARD_ID, CARD_TYPE, GOODS_CODE, QUANTITY, TOTAL_AMOUNT, ORDER_COUNT, PAYMENT_VENDOR, SIGN_CHANNEL_CODE, REQUEST_SIGN_SEQ, TXN_DATE, REMARK, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME ) VALUES ( SEQ_SUPPLEMENT_ORDER.NEXTVAL, #{orderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{payStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{thirdUserId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cardId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cardType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{goodsCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{quantity,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{totalAmount,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{orderCount,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{paymentVendor,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{signChannelCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{requestSignSeq,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{txnDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT ID, ORDER_NO, PAY_STATUS, THIRD_USER_ID, CARD_ID, CARD_TYPE, GOODS_CODE, QUANTITY, TOTAL_AMOUNT, ORDER_COUNT, PAYMENT_VENDOR, SIGN_CHANNEL_CODE, REQUEST_SIGN_SEQ, TXN_DATE, PAY_TIME, REMARK, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, PAY_CHANNEL_CODE, MERCHANT_ORDER_NO, PAYMENT_INFO FROM SUPPLEMENT_ORDER WHERE ORDER_NO = #{orderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.update: UPDATE SUPPLEMENT_ORDER SET PAY_STATUS = #{payStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, REMARK = #{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PAY_TIME = CASE WHEN #{payStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'SUCCESS' THEN SYSTIMESTAMP ELSE PAY_TIME END, UPDATE_TIME = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ORDER_NO = #{orderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PAY_STATUS IN ('INIT', 'PROCESSING')

UPDATE SUPPLEMENT_ORDER SET PAY_CHANNEL_CODE = #{payChannelCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, MERCHANT_ORDER_NO = #{merchantOrderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PAYMENT_INFO = #{paymentInfo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PAY_STATUS = 'PROCESSING', UPDATE_TIME = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ORDER_NO = #{orderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PAY_STATUS = 'INIT'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SUPPLEMENT_ORDER_ITEM ( ID, ORDER_NO, ORIG_ORDER_NO, ORIG_TXN_DATE, ORIG_AMOUNT, SETTLE_STATUS, REMARK, ACTIVE_ORIG_ORDER_NO, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME ) VALUES ( SEQ_SUPPLEMENT_ORDER_ITEM.NEXTVAL, #{orderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{origOrderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{origTxnDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{origAmount,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{settleStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NULL, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT ID, ORDER_NO, ORIG_ORDER_NO, ORIG_TXN_DATE, ORIG_AMOUNT, SETTLE_STATUS, REMARK, ACTIVE_ORIG_ORDER_NO, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME FROM SUPPLEMENT_ORDER_ITEM WHERE ORDER_NO = #{orderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY ID

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ID, ORDER_NO, PAY_STATUS, THIRD_USER_ID, CARD_ID, CARD_TYPE, GOODS_CODE, QUANTITY, TOTAL_AMOUNT, ORDER_COUNT, PAYMENT_VENDOR, SIGN_CHANNEL_CODE, REQUEST_SIGN_SEQ, TXN_DATE, PAY_TIME, REMARK, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, PAY_CHANNEL_CODE, MERCHANT_ORDER_NO, PAYMENT_INFO FROM SUPPLEMENT_ORDER WHERE PAY_STATUS = 'INIT' AND CREATE_TIME < SYSTIMESTAMP - NUMTODSINTERVAL(#{timeoutMinutes,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 'MINUTE') ORDER BY ID ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit,jdbcType=NUMERIC}
mapper.update: UPDATE SUPPLEMENT_ORDER SET PAY_STATUS = 'CLOSED', REMARK = #{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATE_TIME = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ORDER_NO = #{orderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PAY_STATUS = 'INIT'

UPDATE SUPPLEMENT_ORDER SET PAY_STATUS = 'SUCCESS', REMARK = #{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PAY_CHANNEL_CODE = NVL(#{payChannelCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PAY_CHANNEL_CODE), MERCHANT_ORDER_NO = NVL(#{merchantOrderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, MERCHANT_ORDER_NO), PAYMENT_INFO = NVL(#{paymentInfo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PAYMENT_INFO), PAY_TIME = SYSTIMESTAMP, UPDATE_TIME = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ORDER_NO = #{orderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PAY_STATUS IN ('CLOSED', 'FAIL')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ID, ORDER_NO, PAY_STATUS, THIRD_USER_ID, CARD_ID, CARD_TYPE, GOODS_CODE, QUANTITY, TOTAL_AMOUNT, ORDER_COUNT, PAYMENT_VENDOR, SIGN_CHANNEL_CODE, REQUEST_SIGN_SEQ, TXN_DATE, PAY_TIME, REMARK, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, PAY_CHANNEL_CODE, MERCHANT_ORDER_NO, PAYMENT_INFO FROM SUPPLEMENT_ORDER WHERE PAY_STATUS IN ('INIT', 'PROCESSING') OR (PAY_STATUS IN ('CLOSED', 'FAIL') AND UPDATE_TIME >= SYSTIMESTAMP - NUMTODSINTERVAL(#{closedLookbackHours,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 'HOUR')) ORDER BY CASE WHEN PAY_STATUS IN ('INIT', 'PROCESSING') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CREATE_TIME ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit,jdbcType=NUMERIC}
